entries.title: Paseo v0.17.2
entries.note: 0.17.2 - 2026-11-22 Turn and session stats: View per-turn and session timing, token, cache, and cost metrics for Claude, OpenCode v2, Pi, Oh My Pi, and plugin providers. ( #10496 , #10510 ) Automatic model list refresh: Enabled providers refresh their model lists in the background every 30 minutes. ( #10481 ) Sidebar usage by default: The sidebar usage summary is enabled by default, sources for inactive providers start hidden, and source toggles move to a Sources list. ( #10491 ) Agents can steer turns: Agents can steer another agent's running turn alongside queueing or interrupting it, and receive delivery guidance in the response. ( #10193 ) Use existing worktrees: Start a workspace in a worktree you already have, or create one from a branch or pull request. ( #10289 , #10385 ) Watch PRs and MRs: Ask an agent to watch a pull or merge request for new checks, reviews, and comments. ( #10148 , #10279 , #10280 ) Heartbeats in Background work: See and stop an agent's heartbeats next to its background tasks. entries.title: Paseo v0.17.0-beta.1
entries.note: 0.17.0-beta.1 - 2026-11-19 Use existing worktrees: Start a workspace in a worktree you already have, or create one from any branch or pull request. ( #10190 ) Antigravity approvals and history: Pick a permission mode, answer tool approvals, import CLI sessions and see your history when you reopen a chat. ( #10193 ) Watch pull requests: Agents can watch a GitHub PR and get notified when checks, reviews or comments change. ( #10148 ) Heartbeats in Background work: See and stop an agent's heartbeats next to its background tasks. ( #10097 , #10216 ) Agent messages wait their turn: Reports and notifications from other agents arrive when the current turn ends instead of interrupting it. ( #9757 ) Plugin agent instructions: Plugins can add their own instructions to agents. ( #9781 ) All changes Added Added shortcuts to open the model picker and cycle thinking levels with Cmd/Ctrl+/ and Cmd/Ctrl

entries.title: Paseo v0.16.0
entries.note: 0.16.0 - 2026-11-16 Background tasks: See and stop background tasks above the composer for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode v2. ( #6220 , #9162 , #9635 by @fxlelouarn ) Built-in plugin gallery: Browse, search and install plugins without leaving Paseo. Manage their settings and updates from the same page. ( #9752 ) Command center tabs: Switch between Workspaces, Files and Actions, with recent workspaces shown first. Search now includes archived workspaces and matches agent titles within their workspace. ( #9689 ) Plugin sidebar views: Plugins can replace the sidebar with their own workspace and agent layout across connected hosts. Choose a view per device in Settings → Sidebar. ( #8906 ) Plugin composer controls: Plugins can add composer controls, edit drafts and attachments, and change agent settings.
